facts.text: We can use Amazon S3 (Simple Storage Service) to store educational content for the Amazon Cockatoo application.
The educational content stored in Amazon S3 can include videos, images, documents, and audio files.
Amazon S3 is highly scalable and durable.
Amazon S3 is reliable.
We can use Amazon API Gateway for the backend of the application.
Amazon API Gateway creates and manages a RESTful API for the application.
Amazon API Gateway makes it easy to create, test, and deploy APIs.
Amazon API Gateway has built-in support for securing APIs using OAuth and other authentication methods.
We can use Amazon Lambda to execute backend code for the application.
Amazon Lambda is a serverless compute service.
Amazon Lambda allows developers to write code in response to events without worrying about underlying infrastructure.
When a user requests content, Lambda can retrieve content from Amazon S3 and serve it to the user.
We can use Amazon Cognito to manage user authentication and authorization.
Amazon Cognito supports user sign-up, sign-in, and access control.
Amazon Cognito integrates with other AWS services like API Gateway and Lambda.
We can use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor and analyze the application's performance.
Amazon CloudWatch provides metrics and logs to monitor the health and performance of the application.
Amazon CloudWatch can trigger alarms and notifications based on specific metrics.
